content.text: When can you see the main Moon phases? A first quarter Moon rises around midday and is best in the evening; a full Moon rises at sunset and sets at sunrise; a third quarter Moon rises around midnight. Save it for your next clear night. Photo: NASA/Bill Ingalls, the full Moon over the U.S. Capitol in the early evening.
